verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automations or autonomous background workflows in 2FAS. Encrypted iCloud/Google Drive sync is a built-in background behavior, not an automation the user sets up, so it is only adjacent. The llms.txt probe also states there is no public API for agents to call.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
